这就是Hunyuan+Foley，视频声音生成器的工作流程。经测试，其发声效果极佳，且运行所需显存不高。值得推荐！如果对音质有更高的要求，可以通过增加步数来实现。


本地部署安装步骤：
1.下载混元+Foley模型：
https://huggingface.co/tencent/HunyuanVideo-Foley/tree/main
放置文件夹：models\hunyuan_foley
2.下载siglip2模型：
https://huggingface.co/google/siglip2-base-patch16-512/tree/main
放置文件夹：models\hunyuan_foley\siglip2
3.下载CLAP文本模型：
https://huggingface.co/laion/larger_clap_general/tree/refs%2Fpr%2F2
放置文件夹：models\hunyuan_foley\clap
4.安装插件
https://github.com/vantagewithai/Vantage-HunyuanFoley?tab=readme-ov-文件
放置文件夹：custom_nodes
5. 在插件目录（custom_nodes\Vantage HunyuanFoley）中运行命令：
pip install -r 要求.txt


注意：如果需求过程中出现依赖冲突提示，可以尝试运行命令：
pip install protobuf==3.19.6 扩散器 timm 变压器 描述音频工具 omegaconf


详细请参考原作者对该插件的介绍。需要注意的是，该模型需要大量依赖，安装起来比较困难。

This is Hunyuan+Foley, Video Sound Generator workflow. After testing, its sound generation effect is excellent, and the required video memory for operation is not high. It is worth recommending! If there is a higher demand for sound quality, it can be achieved by increasing the number of steps.


Local deployment installation steps:
1. Download Hunyuan+Foley model:
https://huggingface.co/tencent/HunyuanVideo-Foley/tree/main
Place folder: models \ hunyuan_foley
2. Download the siglip2 model:
https://huggingface.co/google/siglip2-base-patch16-512/tree/main
Place folder: models \ hunyuan_foley \ siglip2
3. Download the CLAP text model:
https://huggingface.co/laion/larger_clap_general/tree/refs%2Fpr%2F2
Place folder: models \ hunyuan_foley \ clap
4. Install plugins
https://github.com/vantagewithai/Vantage-HunyuanFoley?tab=readme-ov-file
Place folder: custom_nodes
5. Run the command in the plugin directory (custom_nodes \ Vantage HunyuanFoley):
pip install -r requirements.txt


Attention: If there is a dependency conflict prompt during the requirements process, you can try running the command:
pip install protobuf==3.19.6 diffusers timm transformers descript-audiotools omegaconf


Please refer to the original author's introduction of the plugin for details. It should be noted that this model requires a lot of dependencies and is difficult to install.
